title: MATLAB: reattach an existing license and check native execution
chapter_timing: Receipt-bound logical chapters include control cue, actual transition and confirmation; durations are video times.

steps.title: Your goal: connect your MATLAB license
instructions: Configure your institution’s MATLAB license, connect any required network bridge and check ISSM readiness.
Have your institution’s port@server address and an approved connected cloud account ready.
Open CryoLauncher and sign in. Use an approved connected cloud account with its resources prepared.
The following steps select this tutorial’s model and example.
steps.why: Keep the source inputs, inspect native fields, and save a complete result package. Your workspace keeps scripts, dataset references and results together.
steps.expected: Your workspace keeps scripts, datasets, run history and results together.
steps.note: This ISSM cloud workflow runs MATLAB. Your institution supplies the usable license. Shared application orientation; the case-specific configuration follows.

steps.title: 1. Choose Cloud and ISSM
instructions: Choose Cloud, then select ISSM.
Open Environment & resources and find MATLAB LICENSE below the AWS connection.
steps.why: Choose the intended interface, model and example before editing or launching a run.
steps.expected: Your cloud account connection must already be verified.
steps.note: Your AWS account connection must already be verified.

steps.title: Already configured? Prepare reattachment
instructions: If the masked input is hidden, open Advanced license configuration. Save the current ARN privately, clear Existing secret ARN, then choose Use existing secret.
First-ever entry skips this step.
steps.why: This recovery reattaches the existing license reference without overwriting its value.
steps.expected: Save the current ARN privately; first-ever license entry skips this conditional step.
steps.note: This clears only the local reference; the AWS secret stays intact. Keep the saved ARN for recovery.

steps.title: 2. Enter your institution’s license address
instructions: Paste your own port@server value into the masked MATLAB license field.
The license address remains masked.
Use the address provided by your institution, rather than copying another institution’s example.
steps.why: The institutional license address stays masked and must be reachable for the native run.
steps.expected: Use the port@server address provided by your institution.
steps.note: Keep license values and secret references out of shared recordings. This demonstration recovers an existing managed license.

steps.title: 3. Configure the license
instructions: Choose Configure license.
Wait for MATLAB license configured.
The raw input clears and the application retains the managed secret reference.
steps.why: This recovery reattaches the existing license reference without overwriting its value.
steps.expected: The typed value does not overwrite this existing secret’s stored value.
steps.note: For this recovery, the existing secret is found and its access is reattached. The typed value is not saved over the existing managed secret.

steps.title: 4. Make the license network reachable
instructions: If the license service is private, run the CryoStack Connector on a host that can reach it.
Off campus, connect your institution’s required VPN first.
steps.why: The Connector gives the cloud job access to a private institutional license service.
steps.expected: Off campus, establish the institution’s required VPN first.
steps.note: Keep that network connection and the Connector running until the native run ends.

steps.title: 5. Open the Connector setup
instructions: Choose Open Connector.
The application opens a pairing request for your Connector.
In the Connector on your workstation, choose Pair with CryoStack and enter your own one-time code.
steps.why: The Connector gives the cloud job access to a private institutional license service.
steps.expected: Keep the Connector and required network connection running during the job.
steps.note: Use the same signed-in user for your application and Connector. The next view resumes with its one-time code hidden. The on-screen code is hidden here; enter your own current code.

steps.title: 7. Re-check the connection
instructions: After pairing, choose Re-check.
Wait for CryoStack Connector connected.
Keep the Connector and required network connection available during the model run.
steps.why: The Connector gives the cloud job access to a private institutional license service.
steps.expected: The same-user bridge is online for the native run.
steps.note: This checks connectivity; it does not execute MATLAB. The readiness check comes next.

steps.title: 8. Review ISSM runtime readiness
instructions: Open Review & Launch and confirm ISSM runtime is Ready.
Review the account, model, resources, time limit and estimated charges before submitting a run.
steps.why: Review confirms the intended model, source, resources and charges before submission.
steps.expected: Review the account, model, resources, time limit and estimated charges.
steps.note: Ready means the configuration checks passed; execution verifies the license path.

steps.title: 9. Verify the license path with execution
instructions: The subsequent Basic SquareIceShelf run completed with native exit code 0.
Its runtime provenance records MATLAB R2024b Update 7 and ISSM 2026.1.
steps.why: A completed native job and its recorded provenance provide execution evidence.
steps.expected: MATLAB R2024b Update 7 · ISSM 2026.1 · native exit code 0.
steps.note: That successful native run confirms that this configured license path supported execution.

steps.title: Keep the configuration scope clear
instructions: This setup reattached an existing managed secret without overwriting its stored value.
The already-configured reset, VPN setup and external code entry are instructions outside this captured viewport; the configuration, pairing prompt, connected status and native execution are shown.
steps.why: Keep the scientific input definitions and numerical qualifications with the result.
steps.expected: This guide reattaches an existing secret; conditional reset, VPN and external entry are explained.
steps.note: Store your license reference privately and keep the successful run’s downloaded provenance.
